page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-2 is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating within the n4d server family, this instance utilizes dedicated CPU allocation to ensure consistent compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core configurations. Given its entry-level resource footprint and lack of bundled local storage or accelerators, the instance represents a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring dedicated but modest compute resources.

The n4d-standard-2 is designed for lightweight general-purpose workloads. Suitable applications include small-scale web serving, microservices, development environments, and basic background tasks that do not require high-performance local disk I/O or specialized hardware acceleration.
